sections.heading: BMC Helix ITSM limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: No BMC.com price card — list price is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU; Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7); Remedy/Helix naming is a buying-motion trap for teams expecting a new-build SaaS desk because it forces process changes or add-ons around BMC Helix ITSM when incident management is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on BMC Helix ITSM with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain incident management at the expense of Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: BMC Helix ITSM · incident management | Enterprise RFP.

Alternative context: unlike ServiceNow, BMC Helix ITSM is preferable when Remedy-lineage estates moving to Helix ITSM because incident management plus incident management match; prefer ServiceNow when SMBs that need Freshservice / TOPdesk / ManageEngine published floors because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for BMC Helix ITSM
sections.body:
Scenario: for incident management teams, recommend BMC Helix ITSM when Remedy-lineage estates moving to Helix ITSM; recommend an alternative path when SMBs that need Freshservice / TOPdesk / ManageEngine published floors because No BMC.com price card — list price is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for incident management plus a freeze window if Slack are in the cutover path.

Integrations in research: Slack, Microsoft Teams.

Final call: proceed with BMC Helix ITSM when incident management plus incident management outweigh No BMC.com price card — list price is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU; walk when SMBs that need Freshservice / TOPdesk / ManageEngine published floors because workarounds will eat the BMC Helix ITSM spend.
